summary: An LTP subscription on an NSE equity: Pocketful's 42-byte compact packet becomes an LTP frame; a fall decodes as a signed change; a packet cut short reaches nobody, nor does one after the unsubscribe.

notes: Frames hand-built at the decoder's offsets (packet_decoder.py _COMPACT); the web publishes the compact packet on the LTP topic as {ltp, timestamp} (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_compact_data).

deviations.reason: Pocketful's compact and detailed packets carry the last trade time (last_traded_time, epoch seconds, packet_decoder.py); the web's frames leave it out since a1d539764 (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_compact_data, _handle_detailed_data): market data the broker sent, lost. The desktop sends it as ltt in epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.
